changeSet.author: practice-projection-join

preConditions.onFailMessage: practice projection trigger already joins practice_group by its own alias
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'enforce_practice_current_revision_projection' AND pg_get_functiondef(oid) LIKE '%ON area.id = practice.practice_group_id%'

changeSet.comment: Join the practice group by the alias the group vocabulary left it under, so writing a practice can commit.
